ashby:benchling:bafdc1eb-9742-4769-9d93-.summary:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

sections.title: ROLE OVERVIEW
paras: The Model Hub team is building a computational platform that provides access to cutting-edge scientific AI models to help scientists and agents design better drugs. Scientific models (e.g. AlphaFold or Boltz2) predict structures, predict scientific properties, and generate new drug designs, acting as a design partner and a major time saver to scientists who are creating life-saving therapeutics.

As the product manager on the team, you'll own the product execution of our scientific AI models products and features, including Model Hub, and drive how customers adopt and grow their usage of these models. You'll split your time between talking with customers to understand their needs and gather feedback, and managing product definition and execution to bring the products they want to life. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll partner closely with engineering, legal, strategy, and sales/GTM to get cutting-edge scientific AI into the hands of the scientists who need it.

It's early days for scientific AI models, both at Benchling and in the industry at large. We'll rapidly iterate with customers and change directions quickly, figuring out new patterns for how we develop and go to market. We'll win if we stay curious and obsess over our customers.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: Own the product roadmap for our scientific model platform — defining and prioritizing the models, features, and capabilities that let scientists run inference fast, reliably, and cost-effectively across a diverse set of scientific models.

Define intuitive and beautiful product experiences across our UI, API, and MCP that let computational users execute high-throughput runs and analyze their results, translating customer needs into clear requirements for engineering.
Work directly with customers to ideate use cases, gather feedback, and grow adoption and usage of our scientific AI models across scientific teams.

Help shape how we build AI at Benchling — driving experimentation, contributing to product and technical direction, and helping evolve our product development and go-to-market practices as the field matures.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS
bullets: 5+ years of product management experience building technical or platform products, ideally in scientific, ML/AI, or other data-intensive domains.
Technical fluency: you can read API specs, reason about system tradeoffs, and have credible conversations with engineers about how scientific models are built and served.
Strong analytical skills, comfortable using data to drive product decisions and to measure and grow adoption and usage.
Collaborative mindset, able to work closely with engineers, scientists, and partners across legal, strategy, and GTM to bring new ideas to life.
Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift and rapid experimentation is encouraged.

Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.

Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.

sections.title: About the role:
paras: Our members are solo entrepreneurs betting their livelihoods on their businesses. Most of them are not tax experts, and they shouldn’t have to be. As a Member Success Manager (MSM), you are the person who makes them feel looked after: you explain what’s happening with their taxes, payroll, and books in plain language, you catch problems early, and you help them make smart decisions as their business grows.

We are building toward a model where the routine work (chasing a document, nudging a bank connection, confirming a step) is handled by automation, and your time goes to what needs a person: judgment, technical depth, and real human conversations with members.

This is a proactive role, not a reactive one. You won't just be responding to tickets. You'll be working your queue and book systematically. Knowing who's at risk before they ask, spotting the members ready for the next step, and showing up early instead of late. The members you serve deserve someone in their corner before something goes wrong, and that’s how success will be measured in this role.

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets: Guide members through the questions that keep solo business owners up at night: S-Corporations, reasonable salary, quarterly check-ins, estimated taxes, payroll, and how Collective works end to end.
Resolve member needs quickly and warmly, and bring in our tax and accounting specialists when a case calls for them.

Help members grow with us. When an upgrade, an added service, or a referral truly fits their situation, you have the conversation and close it, on the strength of the value to them rather than a quota.
Use automation and AI as part of how you work, and tell us where they shine and where a human needs to step in.
Keep clear records in Salesforce and our internal systems so every member’s story travels with them.
Bring back what you hear from members to Product and Operations. Your input shapes what we build.

Resourceful, adaptable, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with a passion for helping entrepreneurs.

ashby:delinea:870e5dea-9a82-4a95-941e-34.summary:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

sections.title: Summary:
paras: As a Senior Product Manager for Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security, you will define and execute the strategic vision for Delinea's non-human and machine identity portfolio. Non-human identities now vastly outnumber human ones, spanning service accounts, secrets, API keys, tokens, certificates, workloads, and, increasingly, autonomous AI agents. Your mission is to help the world's largest organizations discover, control, and continuously improve the security posture of every non-human identity across cloud and traditional infrastructure. This is one of the fastest-growing and highest-risk frontiers in identity security.

You will own the strategy and execution of Delinea’s NHI strategy that is standards-based to extend Delinea's leadership in discovery, control, and posture management. You will operate with a high degree of ownership, leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing key stakeholders, and ensuring the NHI portfolio continues to evolve as a market-leading part of Delinea's Identity Security Platform. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the United States.

sections.title: What You'll Do:
bullets: Develop and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy for Delinea's non-human identity (NHI) portfolio, aligning roadmap direction with overall company goals and the evolving Delinea Platform strategy.
Own the roadmap, execution, and lifecycle related to the needs of privileged access by and identity security of workloads.
Balance customer outcomes, technical investment, competitiveness, and business priorities.
Define and deliver modern, NHI capabilities for machine identities across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
Independently lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from ideation and market analysis through execution, launch, and ongoing optimization.
Collaborate closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to deeply understand needs, validate requirements, and identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, architecture, sales, marketing, support, and customer success to prioritize, deliver, and bring capabilities to market.
Define adoption and success metrics, and use data to inform prioritization, measure impact, and demonstrate the business value of the NHI portfolio.

sections.title: What You'll Bring:
paras: For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.

ashby:openai:a8210588-a178-4afe-91e7-1fa.summary:

We bring together OpenAI’s models, financial data, and enterprise knowledge to build products that fit how financial professionals work.

paras: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build OpenAI’s financial services products. Reporting to the GM of Financial Services, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key experiences, taking them from customer discovery and early prototypes through launch, adoption, and iteration. You will spend time with bankers, investors, analysts, and other finance professionals; build and test early product experiences; and work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and customer-facing teams to ship. Go deep on financial workflows. Sit with customers, observe how they work, and understand the documents they create, data they trust, tools they use, and standards they apply. Use those insights to design experiences that customers return to in their daily work.

Build and ship. Create working prototypes, demos, example outputs, and product requirements using Codex and other OpenAI tools. Partner with Engineering and Design to turn early concepts into reliable products, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery through launch and iteration.

Make products work inside financial institutions. Translate integration, data-access, privacy, security, and review requirements into product decisions. Work across Legal, Security, Partnerships, and core product teams to address deployment barriers and determine which needs require finance-specific solutions.

sections.title: You might thrive in this role if you:
bullets: Have a track record of taking complex products from discovery through launch and sustained adoption, as a product manager, founder, or builder with substantial product ownership.

Understand financial work well enough to earn credibility with demanding practitioners. You may have built products for financial institutions or worked directly in investment banking, investing, equity research, corporate development, or related fields.
Combine strong product taste with attention to detail. You care about making complex workflows feel simple and can judge both the experience and the quality of its outputs.

Work comfortably with engineers and researchers on model behavior, data quality, integrations, and evaluations. You can distinguish a model limitation from a data, workflow, or product-design problem.
Use AI deeply in your own work and build prototypes to test ideas. You are willing to teach, onboard, debug, and inspect outputs alongside customers.
Know how to choose useful goals and metrics, test assumptions, and change priorities when the evidence changes.
Bring sound judgment about privacy, trust, and accuracy in consequential professional work.
Take ownership in ambiguous situations, drive decisions across teams you do not manage, and communicate clearly. You can set direction and stay close to the details required to ship.

Think about the last time you tried to book a tennis court. Or sign your kid up for a swim lesson. Or find an open rec league that actually fits your schedule. You probably ended up on a website that looked like it was built in 2003 — or god forbid, filled out a piece of paper.

$3T is spent on recreation globally, and it's built on a completely fragmented system that's largely untouched by technology.

At Rec ( recreation.ai ), we're using AI to change that — reimagining how the world plays, participates in community, and gets active. Our vision is simple: more activity for everyone. ashby:runway-ml:0de946b6-757b-48b1-a0a7-.summary:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

ashby:tavus:8cdea346-6204-4bb5-ab6e-bcd1.summary:
Tavus customers are building products and experiences with conversational AI. Getting from a signed contract to a successful deployment takes more than access to the platform. Customers need clear priorities, a workable implementation plan, and a partner who understands what they are trying to accomplish.

You will report to our Customer Lead and take ownership of an existing portfolio of customers, helping them move through implementation, adoption, and renewal. You will run the day-to-day relationship, coordinate technical partners, and keep customer commitments moving.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful independence. Your portfolio will include ongoing implementations and established customers between renewal cycles. You will inherit unfinished work, build trust with customers, and establish a clear plan for what happens next.

sections.title: What you will do
bullets: Own your portfolio. Build relationships with the people using, implementing, and buying Tavus. Understand their business objectives, success criteria, decision process, and reasons to renew.

Turn customer goals into working plans. Establish milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision dates. For new customers, work with Sales and Customer Engineering to carry the buying context and agreed scope into onboarding. For existing customers, reconstruct missing context and reset the plan where needed.

Run dependable customer communication. Acknowledge requests, clarify their impact, secure the right internal owner, and set the next update. Keep customers informed when answers or delivery dates change, without requiring them to chase.

Drive adoption and customer value. Identify stalled implementations, weak engagement, and unrealized use cases. Determine whether the constraint is product quality, implementation, customer capacity, sponsorship, or fit, and coordinate a practical intervention.

Prioritize across accounts. Allocate attention using customer impact, revenue, growth potential, urgency, and implementation complexity. Make tradeoffs explicit when competing requests exceed available capacity.

Coordinate technical work. Give Customer Engineering, Support, Product, and Engineering useful context: what the customer is experiencing, what they have tried, what is blocked, and why it matters. Track the work through a verified answer or agreed next step.

Run renewal preparation and execution for assigned accounts. Understand renewal intent early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, develop a recommendation, and coordinate the process through a decision. Partner with the Customer Lead and Sales on negotiation and commercial approvals.

Identify credible expansion opportunities. Connect additional use cases to a buyer, a business outcome, and a feasible deployment path. Bring qualified opportunities to the appropriate commercial owner.

sections.title: How ownership works
paras: You own the relationship, account plan, customer communication, and commercial readiness of your assigned portfolio. You are responsible for keeping work moving across teams and making unresolved decisions visible.

Customer Engineering owns technical implementation and troubleshooting. Product and Engineering own platform fixes and technical readiness. You work closely with those teams to establish owners, communicate confirmed capabilities and limitations, and agree on the next customer checkpoint.

When a request lacks an owner, a credible delivery plan, or an agreed scope, you escalate with the customer impact, options, and decision needed. You are comfortable setting expectations and explaining tradeoffs without promising work another team has not committed to deliver.

sections.title: What you bring
paras: We care about demonstrated ownership and judgment across these responsibilities. Relevant experience may come from Customer Success, technical account management, implementation, or another customer-facing role with substantial account responsibility.
bullets: Experience independently managing a portfolio of B2B customers through implementation, adoption, and renewal.
Experience with APIs, AI, infrastructure, developer tools, or another technical product where customer implementation materially affects success.
The ability to enter an account with incomplete information, ask focused questions, and establish a coherent plan.
Commercial judgment: you can connect product performance, usage, customer economics, sponsorship, and business value to retention and expansion.
Strong follow-through across several accounts and internal teams. You keep commitments visible and recognize when a stalled next step requires a decision.
Clear writing and sound judgment in difficult customer conversations. You communicate uncertainty honestly, bring bad news early, and adapt the detail to your audience.
Enough technical fluency to understand an integration, gather useful evidence, and work credibly with engineers. Production software development is not a requirement.
Evidence that you can prioritize competing demands, challenge an ineffective proposed solution, and set realistic expectations while maintaining trust.

sections.title: What success looks like
paras: In your first 30 days , you understand your initial portfolio, meet the key customer and internal stakeholders, and establish the current state of each account. You can explain what the customer wants to achieve, what is blocked, what has been promised, and what happens next. You and the Customer Lead agree on the account handoff, priorities, and escalation boundaries.

By 60 days , you independently run the customer cadence for your assigned accounts. Customers know who owns their relationship and when to expect updates. Active implementations have a shared plan, material risks are visible, and upcoming renewals have a clear recommendation and next steps.
By 90 days , the agreed portfolio has transferred to you:
bullets: Routine customer communication and account coordination proceed without the Customer Lead or an Account Executive directing each interaction.
Commitments have named owners and checkpoints; delays and decisions surface before customers need to chase.
Technical issues reach the right team with useful context, and customers receive accurate updates through resolution or an agreed disposition.
Adoption interventions and renewal plans are grounded in customer evidence, with progress and remaining constraints clearly understood.
Recurring problems produce improvements to guidance, handoffs, or operating practices.
The Customer Lead participates through scheduled portfolio reviews and defined escalations, with more capacity for strategic accounts and the broader customer organization.

sections.title: About Vanta
paras: We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

OpenAsset is the leading growth platform for the Architecture, Construction, and Engineering industries, trusted by 1,100+ clients over 20+ years. Our mission is to transform AEC workflows by connecting people, projects, and data so teams can capitalize on existing knowledge, act with clarity, and win more work with confidence. paras: We’re a diverse, collaborative, and fast-growing team of 110+ employees with offices in New York, London, and Australia and a global client base. Backed by Marlin Equity Partners, we’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and has a voice, and we actively hire from a diverse pool of candidates.
Digital Customer Success Lead Description

As our Digital Customer Success Lead, you will help a growing pooled portfolio of approximately 300 OpenAsset clients representing roughly $5M in ARR get more value from their investment. You will combine practical product guidance with one-to-many program design, creating a customer experience that gives clients timely help, builds confidence with OpenAsset Source, and scales beyond a traditional one-to-one coverage model. This is a foundational opportunity to define how OpenAsset supports customers who do not have a traditional dedicated CSM. You will establish proactive engagement cadences, turn recurring questions into useful self-service resources, and use customer health, product usage, automation, and AI to make outreach more relevant. Your work will help AEC firms get lasting value from their project information and digital assets while creating a stronger foundation for future adoption of the broader OpenAsset platform, including Shred.

You will work closely with CS leadership, Account Managers, CSMs, Product, Marketing, Operations, Sales Engineers, and technical teams. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving real client problems while also building the programs, workflows, and measurement practices that can support hundreds of customers as OpenAsset grows.
bullets: Establish a baseline for the pooled portfolio by analyzing client needs, adoption patterns, existing resources, coverage gaps, and signals that indicate risk or opportunity.
Create a repeatable process for responding to pooled clients' configuration, product, and training questions, with clear escalation paths to CSMs, technical teams, Product, or other partners.

Launch segmented engagement plays such as targeted outreach, office hours, webinars, lifecycle campaigns, and self-service resources that improve adoption without requiring every interaction to be one-to-one.
Translate recurring customer questions and product friction into reusable help content, enablement resources, and recommendations for Product and CS leadership.

Use customer health, product usage, and engagement data to prioritize outreach, identify adoption gaps, measure program effectiveness, and recommend where human attention will have the greatest impact.
Partner with CSMs and CS leadership to define the ideal profile for pooled coverage and create a scalable way to identify eligible clients from CSM-owned books.

Guide clients through OpenAsset Source workflows, troubleshoot configuration and workflow questions, and connect relevant Shred or broader platform opportunities to Account Managers and product specialists.

Use AI and automation to draft and personalize communications, summarize interactions, surface recurring patterns, and improve the speed and relevance of customer support while validating outputs and applying sound judgment.

bullets: Define a healthy ecosystem: Set the metrics that actually matter - usage, attach rate, retention lift, connections health etc and build the reporting and instrumentation that tracks ecosystem health

Every business in America needs a bank account to exist. The system that decides whether they're real, who's behind them, and whether they're a risk, runs on infrastructure from the 1980s. We're rebuilding that layer from scratch.

Baselayer is the identity layer for institutions across the United States: the most complete business graph in America and every human tied to it. We fuse public records, IRS data, sanctions lists, web signals, and fraud telemetry from 2,200+ financial institutions into a single graph that resolves any business and the humans behind it in milliseconds. The legacy credit bureaus took 50 years to build something that gets 60% match rates. We've built something that gets 98% in under two years.

sections.title: ABOUT BASELAYER
paras: Today we're trusted by over 20% of financial institutions in America including FIS, Rho, Socure and top five US banks. But the graph is becoming infrastructure for anyone who needs to know if a business is real and worth trusting: gig platforms, marketplaces, AI companies, and commerce infrastructure at scale.
Trust is the substrate of every financial transaction. We're rebuilding it.

sections.title: ABOUT THE TEAM
paras: AI agents are starting to transact: opening accounts, buying services, moving money on behalf of the businesses and people behind them. Every one of those transactions has a counterparty asking the question banks have always asked: who am I dealing with, and can I trust them? Today's identity infrastructure wasn't built to answer it at agent speed.

The Agentic Economy team is extending Baselayer's business graph into the trust layer for agentic commerce: verifiable credentials that bind an agent to the verified business and human behind it, a registry counterparties can query in real time, and verification APIs that plug into the networks, platforms, and protocols where agent transactions happen.

We run like a startup inside a startup: a small senior team led by our GM of Agentic Economy, working directly with payment networks, banks, wallet providers, and agent platforms. The category is being defined right now; the standards, seats, and infrastructure decisions of the next 18 months will be consequential for a decade.

Define how the recorded state of each asset relates to what live network data shows, and what happens when they differ.

Partner with engineering on identity and reconciliation rules: when records from sensors, integrations, and spreadsheets describe the same physical asset, which source wins for each field, and how every value stays traceable.
Engineering builds the matching; you define what it must get right.

Shape the default workflows customers start from (planned and unplanned change, vulnerability remediation, asset changes, safety approvals) on a configurable workflow engine, including what proves a change was actually done.
Define how the platform works alongside systems customers already run, such as an existing CMDB or ITSM tool: which system owns which record, and how work flows between them.
Help decide where an AI agent acts and where a person must approve.

paras: The Account Manager, Special Loans and Restructuring, is responsible for managing commercial default files, certain commercial loans designated as “problem accounts ”, which include but are not limited to conventional and construction facilities while adhering to underwriting standards and the Company’s policies and procedures (including AML requirements, as applicable). The incumbent is responsible for enforcing the conditions of the mortgage contract on facilities in default as directed by Management, while providing proactive and efficient resolutions/work out strategies to avoid legal action when feasible while minimizing losses to the Bank. The incumbent at times will act as the key primary contact for communicating and co-operating with both internal and external stakeholders (such as legal counsel, real estate agents, brokers, partners, and other internal departments within the Bank) and representing the Bank in the professional community to ensure transactions are processed in a timely and efficient manner.

The Account Manager, Special Loans and Restructuring will provide direct support to the Associate Director, Special Loans and Restructuring by performing a variety of functions associated with default management, including underwriting/credit analysis, portfolio management/monitoring, reporting, projects and initiatives and other administrative duties, which may include assisting with ad hoc requests by Senior Management.
In addition, the incumbent will assist with completing site inspections as required for portfolio management purposes and/or default loans.

sections.title: The Core Responsibilities
paras: The incumbent will manage and/or administer delinquent and problem commercial mortgages ( generally Small Commercial loans ranging up to $2.5MM while minimizing losses to the Bank, process loans for legal action for non-payment (including past maturities, tax arrears, insurance cancellations, bankruptcies/liens, etc.) and conduct full financial review prior to recommending appropriate legal remedies to Management, manage legal action loans and enforce on remedies/conditions as warranted, while ensuring compliance with established default/workout strategies are implemented in a timely and efficient manner. Liaising with key stakeholders, both internal and external, will be a key responsibility, and forms part of determining and negotiating successful workout strategies.

The incumbent is responsible for performing, reviewing, and correlating all aspects of underwriting (including collateral analysis and valuation) for defaulted loans and problem accounts, while ensuring that each submission addresses heightened risk elements, as identified, including monitoring and ensuring risk ratings on default loans are updated timely and reported to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

The incumbent will work closely with the Mortgage Services team and provide assistance to manage, monitor and/or resolve commercial delinquencies and certain default loans deemed to be non-performing, while providing timely updates to Management as warranted.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: Must be located within the sales territory in any of the following states: MA, NH, RI, ME, VT, CT, NY or NJ.
bullets: Executive Relationship Management — Build and deepen multi-level relationships within your assigned accounts, from IT and service desk teams all the way to CIO and C-suite. You are the trusted advisor your clients call when they have a problem or an opportunity.

Virtual Team Leadership — Orchestrate internal Nexthink resources across functions and geographies to deliver an outstanding client experience. You set the tone, lead the strategy, and hold everyone accountable to the customer's success.
Global Account Development — Manage worldwide deployment and development of your assigned accounts, including coordinating resources across regions to ensure consistent, high-impact engagement.

Financial Performance — Own your book of business. You are responsible for achieving targets across licenses, renewals, and professional services — with full visibility and accountability for the commercial health of your portfolio.

bullets: 10+ years of enterprise technology sales or account leadership, with a track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar revenue targets
2+ years in a Client Director, Strategic Account Executive, or equivalent role managing and growing large, complex enterprise accounts
Direct experience in IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, Digital Employee Experience, or adjacent enterprise software categories
Demonstrated success engaging and influencing at the executive level — including CIO, CHRO, and other C-suite stakeholders

bullets: You are a strategic thinker and a skilled operator — you can build a three-year account vision and close the quarter
You run disciplined pipelines, qualify rigorously, and don't chase the wrong opportunities
You are a natural relationship builder — people trust you because you do what you say you're going to do
You are intellectually curious and learn fast — Nexthink operates in a fast-moving market, and you adapt quickly
You lead virtual teams by influence, not authority — and you're good at it
You bring the hunger of a seller and the credibility of a trusted advisor

sections.title: Why Nexthink — Why Now
bullets: Market leadership. Nexthink is recognized as a leader in the Digital Employee Experience space by Forrester and Gartner. We are not chasing the category — we are defining it.
Real executive access. Your accounts are among the world's largest enterprises. You will operate at the highest levels of IT and business leadership.
Significant earning potential. Your portfolio includes Nexthink's most strategic accounts. The upside is real and tied directly to your ability to grow relationships and deliver value.

A product that works. Customers choose Nexthink because it solves real problems — reducing IT costs, cutting ticket volume, improving employee satisfaction, and accelerating transformation programs. You will never struggle to show ROI.
A team that invests in you. You will have access to dedicated Solution Consulting, Professional Services, and executive support to help you win and retain at the highest level.

smartrecruiters:servicenow:7440001607401.summary:
As a Staff Technical Product Manager for ServiceNow University, you will help shape the next generation of artificial intelligence-native learning and credentialing experiences for customers, partners, employees, and individual learners.

ServiceNow University is transforming how people build the knowledge and skills needed to succeed with ServiceNow. The product is evolving toward personalized, proactive, conversational, and hands-on experiences that help learners achieve their goals at the moment of need. This direction is consistent with the current ServiceNow University strategy, which emphasizes artificial intelligence-driven simulation, real-time guidance, skills intelligence, intelligent pathways, and measurable learner capability.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: You will own defined technical product capabilities that support this transformation and span multiple ServiceNow University experiences. You will work alongside ServiceNow University product managers and partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Design, Research, Data, and shared platform teams to translate learner and business needs into scalable capabilities, clear technical requirements, and executable product plans.

By balancing learner needs, product priorities, platform capabilities, and technical constraints, you will help ServiceNow University effectively use Lux and other shared ServiceNow artificial intelligence and platform capabilities.

sections.title: What You Get to Do in This Role
bullets: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for assigned technical product capabilities within ServiceNow University.

Partner with ServiceNow University product managers to translate learner needs, product strategies, and roadmap priorities into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
Drive the effective use of Lux and other ServiceNow artificial intelligence and platform capabilities across relevant ServiceNow University experiences.

Lead product discovery for capabilities that span multiple product areas, including personalization, conversational experiences, learner data, search, recommendations, and reusable experience components.
Develop a deep understanding of learners, business needs, platform capabilities, and emerging artificial intelligence technologies to influence product decisions and prioritize investments.
Define reusable capabilities, integration patterns, and product standards that enable teams to innovate while delivering a consistent, scalable, and consumer-grade learner experience.
Lead technical product planning by defining requirements, prioritizing investments, evaluating technical trade-offs, and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams.
Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, and Design to deliver scalable, secure, accessible, compliant, and enterprise-ready capabilities.

Own profitable growth and customer relationships for SGS Environmental Services across Maine. As an Environmental Senior Account Manager, you will develop new business, expand and retain existing accounts, and connect customers with environmental analytical services that support their project and compliance needs.

Your work will support customers addressing contaminated sites, water quality, and environmental risk. You will combine consultative selling, disciplined account management, responsive service, and technical collaboration to build long-term customer relationships.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: We are seeking a self-directed commercial professional who can translate customer needs into qualified opportunities, coordinate effectively across technical and operational teams, and maintain accountability from initial engagement through contract handoff.
This is an individual-contributor role with responsibility for building pipeline, achieving revenue targets, retaining assigned customers, and expanding SGS relationships across the territory.

sections.title: A day in the life of a SGS Senior Account Manager
paras:
You will connect customer needs with SGS capabilities, working closely with Client Services and laboratory operations to set clear expectations and support effective handoffs from sales to service delivery.

Job Functions
bullets: Develop and execute a territory and account plan that prioritizes new business, customer retention, account expansion, and profitable revenue growth.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline through targeted prospecting, customer engagement, industry relationships, trade shows, and technical seminars.
Lead discovery conversations, assess customer requirements, and align opportunities with SGS capabilities, capacity, and service expectations.
Develop customer-specific value propositions and advance qualified opportunities through proposal, negotiation, and close.
Manage a portfolio of existing customers, identify expansion opportunities, and serve as the customer advocate within SGS.
Partner with Client Services, laboratory operations, technical experts, and other SGS business lines to coordinate solutions and deliver effective contract handoffs.
Maintain accurate account, activity, opportunity, next-step, and forecast information in the CRM and report progress against agreed performance measures.
Provide market and customer insights to support commercial plans, budgets, forecasts, sales materials, and service-development priorities.

sections.title: Required qualifications
bullets: Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biology, environmental science, or a related field.
At least five years of experience in technical sales, project management, customer service, or a related customer-facing role.
Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships, identify needs, and advance commercial opportunities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.
Self-directed work style, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to prioritize resources and manage multiple opportunities.
Strong critical-thinking and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess customer requirements, solve problems, and interpret business information.
Advanced English-language proficiency.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
